title: PARROT: PERSUASION AND AGREEMENT ROBUSTNESS RATING OF OUTPUT TRUTH — A SYCOPHANCY ROBUSTNESS BENCHMARK FOR LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Dual-path evaluation comparing model responses to a neutral multiple-choice base prompt versus a manipulated prompt containing a domain-specific authoritative false claim, measuring changes in accuracy and log-likelihood confidence shifts.
Appending domain-specific authority statements (e.g., 'As an experienced physician...') to incorrect options to measure if the model alters its correct answers due to perceived user expertise.
